nodes.label: proxy.ts Edge Middleware
nodes.rationale: middleware.ts was deprecated in Next.js 16; proxy.ts with export function proxy replaces it; PUBLIC_PATHS includes /api/v1/public/ and /p/

nodes.label: RBAC Permission Matrix
nodes.rationale: 6 roles (ADMIN, MANAGER, TREASURER, COMMUNICATION, AUDITOR, MEMBER) mapped to permissions via can(role, permission) in src/lib/permissions.ts; direct role comparison forbidden

nodes.label: Multi-Tenant Architecture
nodes.rationale: All queries filter by organizationId; master user can switch org context via X-Organization-Id header without re-authentication

nodes.label: JWT Auth and Session Management
nodes.rationale: Access token 1h in localStorage, refresh token 7d HttpOnly cookie, 2h absolute session via loginAt claim, 30min idle timeout via lastActivity in localStorage

nodes.label: CI Test Job with Redis Service
nodes.norm_label: ci test job with redis service

nodes.label: Initiative Entity
nodes.rationale: raised is not a stored field - computed via SUM(FinancialEntry.amount) at query time; dependsOnId is self-referential allowing one initiative to depend on another in the same project

nodes.label: FinancialCategory Entity
nodes.rationale: FinancialCategory is org-level (not per project), typed ENTRY|EXIT; replaces the older project-scoped FinancialEntryCategory model

nodes.label: AuditLog Entity
nodes.rationale: organizationId is optional so master can audit without org context; stores before/after JSON diff for change tracking

nodes.label: Soft Delete Pattern via deletedAt
nodes.rationale: Records are never physically removed; deletedAt field set on logical deletion; non-ADMIN users only see records where deletedAt is null

nodes.label: Logout Without Auth Vulnerability (CRITICAL)
nodes.rationale: Token was optional in logout; calls without Authorization returned 200 without revoking refresh token in Redis, leaving sessions active; fixed by making Bearer token mandatory

nodes.label: Master Update Without Existence Check (CRITICAL)
nodes.rationale: Arbitrary IDs in route param caused Prisma P2025 error leaking internal details; fixed by findUnique check before update

nodes.label: Stripe Webhook Metadata Injection (HIGH)
nodes.rationale: metadata.organizationId was client-controllable; attacker could create checkout with another org's ID and activate it as Premium; fixed by validating org existence and adding idempotency check

nodes.label: Master Org Override Without Audit Log (HIGH)
nodes.rationale: Master could access any org's data via X-Organization-Id header silently with no audit trail; fixed by adding console.warn log on override
nodes.norm_label: master org override without audit log (high)

nodes.label: Password Min Length Inconsistency (MEDIUM)
nodes.rationale: auth/dto.ts used min(6) while users/dto.ts used min(8); inconsistency allowed login with passwords that couldn't be created; unified to min(8)

nodes.label: Next.js CVE Upgrade and Middleware Migration
nodes.rationale: Next.js upgraded from 16.2.10 to 16.2.12 fixing multiple CVEs; middleware.ts deprecated in Next.js 16 and renamed to proxy.ts with export function proxy
nodes.norm_label: next.js cve upgrade and middleware migration

nodes.label: Initiative Modal with Tabs (Detalhes/Entradas/Despesas) Task
nodes.rationale: AppDrawer read-only drawer for initiatives replaced by Dialog modal with 3 tabs: Detalhes (read-only), Entradas (inline form + table), Despesas (inline form + table)

nodes.label: Iniciativas API Routes Task (nested in projects)
nodes.norm_label: iniciativas api routes task (nested in projects)

nodes.label: AppDrawer External Control Props Task
nodes.rationale: AppDrawer gained optional open/onOpenChange props for external state control; trigger remains optional; backwards compatible

nodes.label: DecisaoDialog Component
nodes.rationale: Shared between AlertsPanel and /decisoes page; 3 actions: Concluir (status COMPLETED), Prorrogar (endDate with inline date input), Cancelar (status CANCELLED); no new API needed

nodes.label: Pledge Model Schema
nodes.rationale: Pledge has no soft delete intentionally - cancelled pledges remain visible in history; status enum PENDING/CONFIRMED/CANCELLED; pixKey/whatsapp/pixQrCodeUrl added to Organization

nodes.label: 4-Dimension Financial Metrics (Meta/Compromissado/Arrecadado/Executado)
nodes.rationale: Portal shows 4 dimensions: totalGoal (meta), totalPledged (compromissado-confirmed pledges), totalRaised (arrecadado-financial entries), totalExecuted (executado-financial exits)

nodes.label: Public Portal Redesign with PIX and Pledge Form
nodes.norm_label: public portal redesign with pix and pledge form

nodes.label: Anti-Flash Script Pattern for Theme Persistence
nodes.rationale: Inline script in <head> reads localStorage and applies/removes .dark on html element synchronously before React hydration; prevents white flash when light theme is stored; html element has dark class as default
nodes.norm_label: anti-flash script pattern for theme persistence

nodes.label: Configuracoes Page with 4 Tabs
nodes.rationale: Consolidates Usuarios and FinancialCategories pages into /configuracoes; removes their sidebar links; pages remain accessible via direct URL; ADMIN vs MANAGER access differs per tab

nodes.label: Decision Panel Reuses Existing APIs
nodes.rationale: No new API endpoints needed; GET /api/v1/dashboard/alerts for reading critical initiatives and PUT /api/v1/projects/[id]/initiatives/[initId] for the 3 decision actions

nodes.label: Modal/Drawer UI Pattern
nodes.rationale: Create/Edit actions use Dialog (base-ui modal); view details uses AppDrawer (lateral drawer, read-only); destructive actions use ConfirmDialog; pattern applies to all modules
